home.subtitle: A lightweight collection of Ethereum / blockchain utilities that run entirely offline in your browser.

seo.homeTitle: Web3 Tools — Free Privacy-First Ethereum & Blockchain Utilities
seo.homeDescription: Free open-source Web3 tools that run 100% locally in your browser: ETH mnemonic generator, Wei/GWei unit converter, ABI interactor, ERC-4337 smart account calculator, testnet faucets, JWT parser and more.

ethMnemonic.name: ETH Mnemonic Generator
ethMnemonic.description: Generate 12/24-word BIP-39 mnemonics locally and derive private keys and Ethereum addresses per BIP-44. Your data never leaves the browser.
ethMnemonic.seoTitle: Ethereum Mnemonic & Private Key Generator (BIP-39) — Web3 Tools
ethMnemonic.subtitle: Generate a BIP-39 mnemonic locally and derive an Ethereum private key and address per the BIP-44 standard.
ethMnemonic.privacyNotice: All computations run locally in your browser. No network requests are made — your mnemonic and private key never leave your device
ethMnemonic.securityWarning: Your mnemonic is your assets. Never share it with anyone. Mnemonics generated here should only be used for learning / testing

abiInteractor.name: ABI Interactor
abiInteractor.description: Interact with any contract via its ABI — read state or send transactions through your wallet. Supports 25+ built-in networks and custom RPC endpoints.
abiInteractor.seoTitle: Ethereum ABI Decoder & Contract Interactor — Web3 Tools
abiInteractor.subtitle: Call read/write functions of any contract by providing its ABI. Connect an EIP-6963 wallet to send write transactions.
abiInteractor.privacyNotice: Read calls and ABI parsing run locally in your browser. RPC requests go directly to the endpoint you select — no intermediary server is involved

aaAddressCalculator.name: Smart Account Calculator
aaAddressCalculator.description: Calculate ERC-4337 smart account (AA) addresses locally using CREATE2. Support SimpleAccount, Safe, Coinbase, Alchemy, Kernel, Biconomy and more.
aaAddressCalculator.seoTitle: ERC-4337 Smart Account Address Calculator (CREATE2) — Web3 Tools
aaAddressCalculator.subtitle: Compute counterfactual addresses for ERC-4337 smart accounts across multiple wallet brands. All calculations run locally.
aaAddressCalculator.privacyNotice: Address calculation runs entirely in your browser. On-chain queries (deployment check, owner lookup) send read-only requests to public RPC endpoints — no sensitive data is transmitted

faucetHub.testnetNotice: All faucets listed below are for testnets only. Tokens received have no real value and are intended for development and testing.

unitConverter.name: Unit Converter
unitConverter.description: Convert token amounts between display units and base units — presets, on-chain ERC-20 lookup, or custom decimals.
unitConverter.seoTitle: Wei / GWei / ETH Unit Converter & ERC-20 Decimals — Web3 Tools
unitConverter.subtitle: Convert amounts between human-readable units and base units with lossless BigInt precision.
unitConverter.noticeLocal: Preset and custom conversions run entirely in your browser. The on-chain lookup tab sends one read-only RPC request to the selected network.

unitConverter.errRpcFailed: RPC request failed. Check the network selection or try again later.

jwtParser.name: JWT Parser
jwtParser.description: Decode JWT tokens locally, inspect claims, and optionally verify signatures with a public key or HMAC secret.
jwtParser.seoTitle: JWT Parser & Decoder — Verify Signature Locally — Web3 Tools
jwtParser.subtitle: Paste a JWT to decode header and payload. Optionally verify the signature with a public key or HMAC secret.
jwtParser.privacyNotice: All decoding and verification run locally in your browser. Your token and key never leave your device.

jwtParser.verifySkipped: No key provided — signature verification skipped.
jwtParser.verifyKeyError: Could not import the key or verify with this algorithm.
jwtParser.verifyUnsupportedAlg: Algorithm "{{alg}}" is not supported for verification.

jwtParser.claimsEmpty: Paste a JWT above to see field descriptions

error.malformed: JWT must have three base64url segments separated by dots (header.payload.signature).
error.invalidBase64: Failed to decode base64url header or payload.
error.invalidJson: Header or payload is not valid JSON.

claims.kid: Key ID used to select the verification key
claims.jwk: JSON Web Key embedded in the header
claims.crit: Critical header extensions that must be understood
claims.iss: Issuer — who created and signed the token
claims.sub: Subject — whom the token refers to
claims.aud: Audience — intended recipients of the token
claims.exp: Expiration time — after this the token is invalid
claims.nbf: Not before — token is not valid before this time
claims.iat: Issued at — when the token was created
claims.jti: JWT ID — unique identifier for the token
claims.auth_time: Time when the end-user authentication occurred
claims.nonce: String value used to associate a client session with a token
claims.azp: Authorized party — the party to which the ID Token was issued

codec.name: Codec
codec.description: Encode and decode text locally with Base64, Base58, Hex, URL, and other common formats.
codec.seoTitle: Base64 / Base58 / Hex Codec — Encode & Decode — Web3 Tools
codec.subtitle: Pick a format, paste text on the left, then encode or decode into the result panel.
codec.privacyNotice: All encoding and decoding run locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

base64.encode: Converts UTF-8 text bytes to standard Base64 (with padding).
base64.result: A–Z, a–z, 0–9, +, / and = padding, e.g. aGVsbG8=

base64url.encode: URL-safe Base64: same as Base64 but uses - and _ instead of + and /.
base64url.result: A–Z, a–z, 0–9, -, _ with optional padding, e.g. aGVsbG8

base58.encode: Bitcoin-alphabet Base58 encoding of UTF-8 bytes (no 0/O/I/l).

base32.encode: RFC 4648 Base32 encoding of UTF-8 bytes.

hex.encode: Encodes UTF-8 bytes as a continuous hexadecimal string.

utf8.encode: Shows each UTF-8 byte in hexadecimal, separated by spaces.

ascii.encode: Shows each ASCII byte as a decimal code (0–127). Non-ASCII input fails.

binary.encode: Expands each UTF-8 byte into an 8-bit binary group.

html.encode: Escapes special / non-ASCII characters as HTML entities.

unicode.encode: Escapes each character as a Unicode escape sequence.

codec.inputPlaceholder: Enter text to encode or decode...
codec.empty: Click Encode or Decode to see the result here

errors.invalidAscii: Invalid ASCII decimal byte codes (or contains non-ASCII bytes).
errors.invalidBinary: Invalid binary string (expect groups of 0/1 bits).
